method.primary_evidence: Official zoo, operator, or government/institution websites and their first-party news, press, RSS, sitemap, or API endpoints.
method.discovery_hints: Search results and third-party directories were used only to locate candidate official domains; they are not used as identity evidence.
method.status_notes: success means an official source suitable for a proposed adapter was found; partial means an official source exists but its listing is JS/API-gated, shared without a zoo-specific filter, or lacks a safe narrow URL path; blocked means the official source is known but the configured Fetcher must fail closed because robots.txt is missing or the relevant official path is disallowed.
method.robots_policy: A HTTP 404/missing robots.txt is recorded as blocked. A robots-disallowed API or archive is not proposed as an active crawl path. No browser automation or robots bypass is assumed.

adapter_proposal.config_notes: Use the server-rendered Story Hub search/news listing and restrict detail links to the Alliance's first-party story/press paths. The visitor site is zoo.sandiegozoo.org, while the current press/news hub is on the official San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance host. Do not use the Alliance sitemap as the primary source without filtering its stale http://live-sdzwa.pantheonsite.io entries.

rows.status_reason: The official zoo site and its operator's Story Hub expose a server-rendered press/news listing with first-party article links; robots.txt is available and does not disallow the proposed path.

adapter_proposal.config_notes: The Bronx Zoo is a Wildlife Conservation Society (WCS) zoo. Use the official WCS newsroom RSS/archive, then retain only entries whose official detail URL or content identifies Bronx Zoo; the WCS feed is operator-wide and also covers other WCS programs and zoos. The source-scoped article_content_selector .article-body passed the bounded live retest below.

rows.status_reason: The official WCS newsroom and operator-wide RSS feed are reachable, eight entries pass the Bronx identity filter, and the source-scoped .article-body selector passed the bounded live retest: the first run fetched and stored one clean 4,429-character article and the second found that article already known, with no content_parse_error or new duplicate.

live_diagnostic.remediation_note: The source-scoped selector passed the two bounded live retest runs; success_claim is based only on these run IDs and their clean fetch/store and already-known evidence.

adapter_proposal.config_notes: Parse the server-rendered current News page's Press Releases and Animal Stories. The historical /news/archive and /news/press-release-archive paths are official but currently disallowed by the site's robots policy and must not be fetched until that policy changes; no official RSS or API was found.

rows.status_reason: The official current news listing is directly crawlable, but robots.txt disallows the historical archive paths, leaving only a limited current listing for a compliant adapter.

adapter_proposal.config_notes: The year-specific press archive is server-rendered and links dated first-party releases; follow its year links and keep detail URLs under /mediaroom/. Enable only after the official host serves a valid robots.txt, because the current HTTP 404 must be treated fail-closed.

rows.status_reason: The official media room and press2026 archive are available as HTML, but https://www.torontozoo.com/robots.txt returns HTTP 404. Under the project's default fail-closed robots behavior this source cannot be crawled yet.

adapter_proposal.config_notes: Use the official English sitemap and filter /en/about-mandai/media-centre/ article URLs; those article pages are server-rendered. The Media Centre index uses a JS filter servlet under /bin/ (robots-disallowed and returning HTTP 500 when called directly), so do not use that API as the adapter path.

js.reason: The article URLs are HTML, but the media-centre index shell loads its listing through a first-party JS servlet.

rows.status_reason: Mandai's official sitemap exposes a usable first-party media-centre URL set, while the current listing is JS-gated and its /bin API is both robots-disallowed and not a reliable direct endpoint.

adapter_proposal.config_notes: The Tokyo Zoological Park Society's Japanese Ueno news archive is server-rendered and uses narrow /ueno/news/ detail paths; the official English mirror may be used as a language-specific alternative. Enable only after the host serves robots.txt, because the current HTTP 404 requires fail-closed blocking.

rows.status_reason: Official Japanese and English Ueno news archives and sitemap are directly available, but https://www.tokyo-zoo.net/robots.txt returns HTTP 404; the default Fetcher therefore cannot proceed.

adapter_proposal.config_notes: Prefer the municipal zoo's official RSS, with the official JSON endpoint as a structured fallback; retain URLs on www.zoo.gov.taipei and the BD065B2FA7782989 news collection. Both Chinese and English listings are server-rendered, but both official hosts currently return HTTP 404 for robots.txt, so enable only after robots is restored.

rows.status_reason: Taipei Zoo has unusually strong official RSS/XML/JSON and HTML news sources, but www.zoo.gov.taipei/robots.txt and english.zoo.gov.taipei/robots.txt both return HTTP 404; fail-closed robots handling blocks the crawl.

adapter_proposal.config_notes: The first-party JSON article-search endpoint is structured but operator-wide. No Sydney-specific category or path filter was verified: the checked page yielded zero verified Sydney-specific candidates. Keep this as a partial/unsupported plan; do not infer Sydney identity or add an unverified query parameter.

js.reason: The newsroom shell is present in HTML, while article results are loaded and paginated by the official SearchApi endpoint.

rows.status_reason: The official Taronga newsroom and first-party article-search API are available and robots.txt permits the host, but the operator-wide API returned zero verified Sydney-specific candidates and no safe Sydney identity filter was established.

adapter_proposal.config_notes: Use only INTERNAL_NEWS records from the public first-party API, paginate with x-page-index, and send the public x-api-key and x-source-id headers exposed by the official Next.js bundle. Reject EXTERNAL_NEWS records whose links leave the official host. Enable only after www.zoologico.com.br serves a valid robots.txt; current HTTP 404 is fail-closed.

js.reason: The press listing is a Next.js page and its structured entries are returned by /v1/press.

rows.status_reason: The official Next.js press page and first-party JSON API are verified, but www.zoologico.com.br/robots.txt and zoologico.com.br/robots.txt both return HTTP 404; fail-closed robots handling blocks the crawl.

adapter_proposal.config_notes: The official RSS and REST API are retained as evidence, but their observed article links are root slugs with no stable news/article path. Keep both disabled; do not use a broad root-slug rule or infer identity from unrelated SANBI pages.

rows.status_reason: The official Pretoria Zoo/SANBI site identifies the National Zoological Garden and exposes first-party RSS and WordPress JSON, but both verified article sets use root-level slugs with no stable news/article path. The broad root-slug URL rule is not safe for this importer, so both sources remain disabled pending a narrower verified path or source-specific URL policy.

Official RSS/XML/JSON and HTML sources are available, but robots.txt returns HTTP 404 on both Chinese and English hosts; fail-closed crawling is blocked.
Official Next.js press API is available with public headers, but robots.txt returns HTTP 404 on both canonical hosts; fail-closed crawling is blocked.
